title: What the bond actually is
alt: Housing and Urban Fund page describing First-Class and Second-Class National Housing Bonds and their issue conditions
note: The First-Class bond is the one a property registration triggers. Its terms are on the bottom row: 1.0% a year, five-year maturity, annual compounding, repaid in a single sum. The Second-Class bond, which older guides still mention, stopped being issued on 31 May 2013 — if a source is telling you about it, the source is at least thirteen years out of date.
redaction: Nothing removed. A public information page on the Housing and Urban Fund site, carrying no personal or business information.
